tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The writing surface and page ground. Cool, never cream: the document is the content, the ground stays out of the way.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that floats over the document: slash menu, suggestion cards, popovers.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside the chrome: code blocks, the menu's query field, hovered rows, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines that only separate. Never the only edge of a control: use rule-strong.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs). 3:1 or better on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: All document text and primary UI text, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken, ink-soft, pencil-soft and stamp-soft.

tokens.name: graphite-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, block type ids, placeholders, sync status, deleted text. On paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and pencil-soft.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The human hand and the local writer: caret, links, accepted state, the local writer's change bars. As text on paper, paper-raised and ink-soft.

tokens.name: ink-fill
tokens.usage: Solid ink fills: the primary button. Stays saturated in dark where ink lightens for text. Text on it is on-ink.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: The local writer's text selection and the accepted tag's ground. graphite and ink read on it.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: AI actors only, as a fill: the fresh tag, the AI mark. Never decoration, never a warning. Text on it is on-pencil. Too light for text or bars on paper; use pencil-text.

tokens.name: pencil-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind text an AI proposed and nobody has accepted yet. graphite and pencil-text read on it.

tokens.name: pencil-text
tokens.usage: AI as a stroke: proposal underlines, the AI change bar, the stale tag. As text on paper, paper-raised and pencil-soft.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: Structure broke: the conflicted state and destructive confirmations. Nothing else, offline included. As text on paper, paper-raised and stamp-soft.

tokens.name: stamp-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a conflicted proposal's explanation. graphite and stamp read on it.

tokens.name: peer-teal
tokens.usage: Remote writer ink 1 of 6: caret, name flag, change bar, selection wash. Text on paper and paper-raised; flag text is on-peer.

tokens.name: peer-violet
tokens.usage: Remote writer ink 2 of 6. Same jobs and grounds as peer-teal.

tokens.name: peer-green
tokens.usage: Remote writer ink 3 of 6. Same jobs and grounds as peer-teal.

tokens.name: peer-sepia
tokens.usage: Remote writer ink 4 of 6. Same jobs and grounds as peer-teal.

tokens.name: peer-magenta
tokens.usage: Remote writer ink 5 of 6. Same jobs and grounds as peer-teal.

tokens.name: peer-slate
tokens.usage: Remote writer ink 6 of 6. Same jobs and grounds as peer-teal.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink-fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: on-pencil
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pencil fill (the fresh tag).

tokens.name: on-stamp
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a stamp fill (the conflicted tag).

tokens.name: on-peer
tokens.usage: Name text on any peer-* flag.

tokens.name: caret
tokens.usage: The local caret. An alias so an integrator can recolor the caret alone.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The local writer's text selection. Remote selections use their peer ink as a wash instead.

tokens.name: machine
tokens.usage: Importer, migration and system actors: their change bars and actor marks. Machines get no hue.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Fallback", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Variable", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Fallback", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Document
groups.note: The reference editor's default document faces. Literata was drawn for long reading on screens. Integrators may swap the family; keep the measure and leading.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: The document's title block. One per document.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: The intro needs one sentence about offline sync before the pricing table.
styles.usage: nooq.paragraph/v1 and list items. The line height is the editor's baseline pitch.

styles.name: doc-quote
styles.sample: The network is an optimization, never a requirement.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Chrome around the document. Atkinson Hyperlegible separates look-alike glyphs (I l 1, O 0) for low-vision readers.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Maya edited this paragraph after the proposal was made.
styles.usage: Menu items, explanations, everything in the chrome that is a sentence.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: State tags, actor kinds, keyboard hints, sync status.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Anything a machine wrote and a person may need to compare: digests, block ids, type ids, ops.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code in documents.

styles.name: digest
styles.usage: Fingerprints, block ids, block type ids, lamport clocks.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: The project's own voice: site headlines and the cover. The writing face at its heaviest.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Site headlines and the wordmark. Never inside the editor.

spacing.note: 4px base. The document side keys off doc-body's 30px line instead (see Editor).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; gap between a button's label and its shortcut.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding; gap between sibling controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and menu padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels; page gutter on the docs site.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks on the docs site.

radius.note: Tight and technical. Blocks are rectangles; only presence dots go round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Change bars, the caret's name flag, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, digests, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Presence dots only.

size.note: Heights of the controls every surface shares, so a chip and a button from different authors line up (§7). Widths follow content.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact inline controls: state tags, digests, actor kinds, keyboard hints. Includes their borders (border-box).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Standard controls: buttons, inputs, the slash menu's glyph tile and column. Includes their borders (border-box).

tokens.name: control-handle
tokens.usage: The block drag handle: a grab target tall enough to hit that stays shorter than a full control.

shadow.note: One elevation for things that float over the document, plus the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The slash menu, popovers and floating suggestion cards. Docked cards use a rule outline instead.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px paper gap, then 2px of solid ink. 4.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

highlight.note: How strongly a wash tints text: a share of pure ink mixed over transparent.

tokens.name: highlight-peer
tokens.usage: A remote writer's selection: their derived peer ink washed over text, inline and as a CSS custom highlight.

motion.note: Durations, not choreography. Nothing animates on the input path (§3): menus may fade and the caret may blink, and that is all. The logo timings live with the logo (brand/geometry.ts), not in the editor theme.

tokens.name: fade
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers fading in — the only entrance animation in the editor.

tokens.name: blink
tokens.usage: The caret's blink half-period: 530ms on, 530ms off; holds steady while the writer types; never blinks under reduced motion.

layer.note: The z-index scale, so plugins and hosts never guess. Presence rides above text, chrome above presence, floating surfaces above chrome, dialogs above everything.

tokens.name: layer-presence
tokens.usage: The presence overlay: remote carets and name flags above the text, below every control.

tokens.name: layer-toolbar
tokens.usage: Block and selection toolbars.

tokens.name: layer-overlay
tokens.usage: What floats over the document: the slash menu, popovers, tooltips, floating notices.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs: the top of the stack, reserved for the P2 work.

editor.note: Geometry of the writing surface, shared by every block type, built-in or third-party.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the text column: about 70 characters of doc-body.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Margin left of every block: drag handle plus change bar. The margin is where provenance lives.

tokens.name: change-bar
tokens.usage: Width of the provenance bar beside a block, colored by its last writer.

tokens.name: caret-width
tokens.usage: Local and remote carets.

tokens.name: block-gap
tokens.usage: Vertical space between sibling blocks.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: The horizontal gutter between layout columns.
